title: THE LAST FRAME
logline: A freelance filmmaker discovers a recording from her future self warning of a train disaster and a betrayal, forcing her to decide if she can alter her predetermined fate.

characters.name: MAYA SEN
characters.description: A 27-year-old freelance filmmaker, the protagonist who discovers a mysterious recording from her future self.

characters.name: FUTURE MAYA
characters.description: A terrified, future version of Maya, seen only in a video recording, delivering cryptic warnings.

characters.name: DANIEL
characters.description: A producer who appears to be aware of the future events and provides Maya with advice.

vfx_requirements: Video playback of 'Future Maya' in a dilapidated apartment
Camera footage showing a mysterious figure behind Maya
Camera footage showing a train derailing

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Maya, a freelance filmmaker, discovers her old digital camera has mysteriously recorded a video from her future self, warning her about an upcoming event and a person named Daniel.

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - LATER
scenes.summary: Maya, disturbed by the video, paces her apartment and considers calling Daniel.

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - LATER
scenes.summary: Daniel contacts Maya, revealing he also saw the future video and urges her to destroy the camera, as the apartment lights flicker and the camera begins recording again.

scenes.heading: INT. TRAIN STATION - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Maya is at the train station at 11:46 PM, where her camera records a figure behind her and then shows the train derailing. Daniel, from inside the arriving train, urges her to get off before the doors close.
